title: Path Variables and Request Parameters
description: Capture dynamic data from URLs using @PathVariable and @RequestParam.

slides.title: Two Ways to Pass Data in URLs 🌐
slides.content:
# Path Variables vs Query Parameters

* **Path Variable** – Part of the URL path (e.g., `/users/42`).
  * Used to identify a specific resource.
* **Query Parameter** – Appended after `?` (e.g., `/users?page=2&size=10`).
  * Used for filtering, pagination, or optional parameters.

quizData.question: Which annotation would you use to capture the value `42` from the URL `/users/42`?
quizData.explanation: @PathVariable binds a template variable in the URI to a method parameter.

slides.title: Using @RequestParam
Best Practices 📌
slides.content: Use **path variables** for resource identification (e.g., `/orders/123`). Use **query parameters** for filtering, sorting, or optional inputs (e.g., `/orders?status=PAID`).
